Structured FAQ sections present on all top-3 English-language pages (Cyclist, Tifosi both confirmed has_faq=true) — these capture People Also Ask boxes and AI Overview inclusion, providing a second organic surface beyond the main blue link

Comparison tables are standard in high-ranking buying guides (Cyclist, 220triathlon, Active.com all use structured spec comparisons) — they create scannability signals and increase time-on-page, both of which correlate with sustained top-3 positions
